layers.name: atmosphere
layers.source: existing theme veil and tide glow

layers.name: subject
layers.motion: absolute playback time; gentle camera and typography

layers.name: ui
layers.source: Tingchao controls, current subtitle, compact track identity
layers.motion: host owns layout; renderer never owns playback

states.enter: lazy load renderer, wait for active lyric fonts, show current readable lyrics meanwhile
states.playing: advance visual MotionValue from runtime anchors
states.paused: stop ticker; redraw only on seek, theme or resize
states.hidden: cancel visual clock, abort initialization, destroy renderer
states.seek: jump absolute time; no replay of expired animation
states.exit: abort handoff, disconnect observer, destroy Pixi scene resources
states.fallback: existing lyric scroll for reduced motion, small stage or renderer failure

safeAreas.desktop: reserve top controls and lower-left track identity
safeAreas.narrow: fall back to readable scroll below 420px stage width or 250px height
